subject: Impact package and case study approval — Atlas Retail expansion
messages:
From: Anna O'Connor <anna@atlasretail.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@atlasretail.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Impact package for renewal expansion

Hi Priya,

We're entering the procurement window for our Q3 expansion and I need a short, objective package that shows the outcomes we achieved with Redwood so I can present to our CFO and procurement. Specifically:

- One-page summary with 3–4 bullet metrics (latency, cost per inference, throughput, uptime).
- Short customer quote (single sentence) we can include in the procurement deck.
- A PDF we can hand to procurement and our legal team for approvals (SOC2 evidence will be requested separately).

Can you put something together this week? If you need approval for a public case study or quote, please let me know who to loop in.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna O'Connor
Senior Product Manager, Atlas Retail
anna@atlasretail.com

--
Attachment: none

From: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Anna O'Connor <anna@atlasretail.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@atlasretail.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Impact package for renewal expansion

Hi Anna — thanks for the note and congrats on getting this to procurement. We can absolutely put together an outcomes package this week. Proposed plan:

1) One-page PDF with headline metrics + short blurb for procurement (we'll include randomized baseline methodology notes).
2) A short quote draft for your approval (1 sentence).
3) A two-page appendix (Atlas-specific dashboard screenshot + metric definitions) for legal and procurement.

I've attached a draft outcomes PDF and a one-pager (stubs) for quick review. If you're comfortable, we would also like to request approval to feature Atlas Retail as a case on our site; we can send a separate approval request with the exact quote and graphics.

Would you be available for a 15-minute sync tomorrow to confirm the numbers? If not, reply with any edits and we'll push a final package.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

--
Attachments:
- redwood_onepager_atlas_v1.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
- AtlasRetail_Q3_outcomes.pdf (PDF, 2 pages, draft metrics)

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Anna O'Connor <anna@atlasretail.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@atlasretail.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Impact package for renewal expansion

Thanks Priya — quick additions from my side that procurement usually asks for:

- Customer-facing ROI bullets (e.g., percent improvement and baseline). I suggest we lead with: "35% median latency reduction at peak load" and "24% reduction in cost per inference for our checkout path" — both measured vs prior infra.
- A sentence about reliability: "Operational uptime of 99.9% during the measured window (Q4)."
- A callout for support/SLAs available with Dedicated contracts if they need predictability.

Anna, if those numbers look right, we can lock them in and I'll propose a short incentive for committing to a 12-month Dedicated plan (covers burst + onboarding discount). Also happy to include a one-sentence executive quote from your team in draft form for you to edit.

Vivek
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: none

From: Anna O'Connor <anna@atlasretail.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@atlasretail.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 13:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Impact package for renewal expansion

Thanks Priya and Vivek — those headline numbers look correct to us. A couple of quick items from procurement/legal:

- The procurement team wants metrics sourced and described (time window, sample size, traffic profile). Please include a one-sentence methodology line for each metric.
- We can approve a public case study, but legal needs to approve the final quote wording. Please send any quote drafts to legal (Tom copied) and to me.
- For the DocuSign route: Tom will be the signee on Atlas's side. He prefers a procurement packet with the PDF + link to any SOC2/attestation docs.

Tom, do you need anything else to move this through?

Anna

--
Attachment: none

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Anna O'Connor <anna@atlasretail.com>, priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@atlasretail.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Impact package for renewal expansion

Anna / Tom — attaching the finalized impact package for your review. Contents:

- redwood_onepager_atlas_v1.pdf — single-page headline + short quote placeholder.
- AtlasRetail_Q3_outcomes.pdf — two-page appendix with metric definitions, methodology, and the dashboard screenshot.
- dashboard_screenshot.png — anonymized performance dashboard (sample view).

Quote draft (please edit): "Switching to Redwood reduced our checkout latency by 35% at peak, cut inference costs by 24%, and improved reliability during promotional traffic — enabling a smoother customer experience."

If this wording is acceptable, Tom can sign the attached procurement acknowledgement (or we can route a DocuSign link). Priya and Vivek — I also added a line about Dedicated contract SLAs + an incentive for a 12-month commit.

Anna — happy to jump on a quick call to walk procurement through the appendix if that helps. Once you confirm, we'll publish the one-pager for your legal sign-off and provide the DocuSign link.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
